Backend: 34/34 pytest tests pass covering auth/role/onboarding/sessions/programs (category+length validation, resize, coach-only)/invites (code + coach_email)/coach clients/assign/activity/stats (with 403 authz)/dashboard (rest-day null, streak)/log-advances-day/progress/Stripe checkout. Frontend (Expo web): coach.demo login lands on Practitioner Home showing 1 client/1 program/100% active + Recent Activity + Needs Attention; Clients tab lists 'Client Demo · Rowing Strength Program · Day 2/7' with On Track chip; client detail shows intake, check-in history, Assign a Different Program modal opens with the coach's program. Fresh signup landed directly on Today tab bypassing role-select and onboarding — this is a HIGH-priority routing bug.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful register/login, login.tsx unconditionally routes to /(tabs) via useEffect(() => { if (user) router.replace('/(tabs)') }, [user]). This skips the role-select and onboarding gates that /app/index.tsx enforces. Fresh signup of testuser+<rand>@cocoachify.com landed on client Today tab as role=null user (also reproduced with legacy testcoach@cocoachify.com — documented no-role account also went straight to Today). Reference: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:34-36.

TabsLayout only checks !user for redirect; it does NOT guard against user.role === null or (client && !onboarding_completed). Users with no role default to client tab layout because isCoach = user?.role === 'coach' is false. Should redirect to /role-select or /onboarding respectively. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:13-17.

issues: Header says '1 Weeks · 3 Days/Week · Intermediate' — grammatical: should be '1 Week' when weeks == 1 (total_days=7).
Program description reads '4-week strength and power' while total_days is 7. Seed content mismatch — cosmetic only.

action_items: FIX login.tsx: after login/register do NOT hardcode router.replace('/(tabs)'). Instead route based on user shape — if !user.role -> /role-select; if role==='client' && !onboarding_completed -> /onboarding; else /(tabs). Simplest: router.replace('/') and let index.tsx (already correct) do the branching.

HARDEN (tabs)/_layout.tsx: if user has no role, Redirect to /role-select; if role==='client' && !user.onboarding_completed, Redirect to /onboarding. This closes the loophole even if some future entry point sends a bare user to /(tabs).
Cosmetic: pluralize weeks label in program header ('1 Week' vs '2 Weeks') and align Rowing Strength Program seed description ('4-week') with actual total_days=7.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the signup→Today bug: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx line 34-36 has `useEffect(() => { if (user) router.replace('/(tabs)') }, [user]);`. As soon as AuthContext receives the new user (with role=null) from register/login, this effect fires and hard-navigates to the tabs group. The (tabs)/_layout.tsx only guards against `!user` (redirects to /login) but does not enforce role/onboarding gates, so it silently renders the client Today tab (since isCoach is false when role is null). The correct place to gate is /app/frontend/app/index.tsx which already has the correct branching; login.tsx should either route to '/' or replicate the same logic. Reproduction: 1) Open /login  2) Toggle to signup  3) Register with a fresh email/password  4) Observe URL becomes '/' and screen is client Today with 0-day-streak greeting the new name — no role-select shown. Mitigation options (recommended #1): change login.tsx redirect to `router.replace('/')` so index.tsx does the branching.
